description_en: Deletes one or more file shares from a file gateway
description_zh: 删除指定文件网关中的指定文件共享

parameters.description_en: The ID of the file share. You can call the DescribeGatewayFileShares operation to query the IDs of file shares.
parameters.description_zh: 文件共享在网关内部的ID。可以通过DescribeGatewayFileShares接口获得。
parameters.help_en: The ID of the file share. You can call the DescribeGatewayFileShares operation to query the IDs of file shares

parameters.name: index_id

parameters.description_en:
Specifies whether to force delete the file share. Valid values:

- true: Force deletes the file share even if data synchronization is incomplete. Use this option with caution.

- false (default): Does not delete the file share if data synchronization is incomplete.
parameters.description_zh:
是否强制删除。可能值：

- true：强制删除同步未完成的文件共享，请谨慎操作。

- false（默认）：不删除同步未完成的文件共享。
